insight.headline: App security updates: IP allowlist due tomorrow
insight.what_changed: The busiest shopping weeks of the year are almost here. Thanks to everyone who’s already turned on an IP allowlist, enabled expiring tokens, and taken other steps to help keep merchants protected when it matters most. This Friday, November 20, is the deadline for IP allowlist. We’re also sharing requirements that start December 1, and tooling updates to help you get ready for the next round of sec…
